name: cube-state-engine
description: An efficient representation in memory for tracking the Rubik's cube state on each movement.

scripts.build: bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:types
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.mjs --format esm --target browser
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --format cjs --target node

author: Bryan Lundberg
